mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feedback (project_id, mentor_id, content, stage) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{mentorId}, #{content}, #{stage})
mapper.select: SELECT feedback_id, project_id, mentor_id, content, stage, feedback_file, created_at FROM feedback WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, feedback_id DESC

SELECT f.feedback_id, f.project_id, f.mentor_id, f.content, f.stage, f.feedback_file, f.created_at, pr.title AS project_title FROM feedback f INNER JOIN project pr ON pr.project_id = f.project_id WHERE f.mentor_id = #{mentorId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.feedback_id DESC
